name: Nishina Nao
source:
Likes: Elaborate and rare food.
Hobby: Cooking

3rd year high school student. An 'Ayakashi-tsuki' who has mystic powers.
He hates being superficially polite and talks harshly, but he has a serious and methodical personality.
He's responsible for the finances and cooking for the Nanjou family.
He takes care of the protagonist by order of her grandfather, Nanjou Shinzou.
